text: Under the declared 2-bit to base mapping (00=A, 01=C, 10=G, 11=U) and the standard genetic code, lexicographic traversal of 000000 through 111111 yields the 24-residue string KNKNTTTTRSRSIIMIQHQHPPPP at the head of a 64-residue product. This sentence is a computational mapping claim only. It does not assert that any physical object encoded, emitted, or intended the mapping.
provenance: physical source: UNRESOLVED — no frozen artifact hash links a Buga sphere, crop formation, or other physical mark to this mapping
test_plan: Recompute every 6-bit string from 000000 to 111111 under the declared mapping and the standard genetic code, without using the target string as an input.
Record entropy, compressed size, methionine position, and stop count in the first 24 residues as measurements of the product, not as proof of intention.

Blind reconstruction: the procedure must be able to reach the stated string without being shown that string as the expected plaintext. A construction that only works while looking at the target is not a decoding.
Independent witness: a second implementation, outside the original reasoning path, must rerun the same frozen procedure before REPRODUCED may be claimed.
Cross-artifact validation: do not treat the mapping as evidence of physical encoding until a separate procedure, with its own failure condition, links marks on a hashed physical artifact to the code.
counter_hypotheses: The 24-residue head is a consequence of lexicographic order plus the standard code, not a message.
Reported features (entropy, compressed size, methionine position, stop count) can be true of the string and still not establish authorship or emission.
Agreement among models would not constitute independent reproduction.
result: TESTED. Computational procedure is defined and recomputable in principle. evidence_state remains HOLD. Blockers still open: physical source, blind reconstruction, independent witness, cross-artifact validation. Do not upgrade this record because the math is determinate.
